item.title: Leakage of Advance Voting Results at Shareholder Meetings Raises Concerns Ahead of Mandatory Cumulative Voting in September (주총 사전투표 결과 유출 관행, 집중투표제 9월 시행에 ‘암초’)
item.description:
At Korea Zinc's regular shareholders' meeting held on March 24, Chairman Choi Yun-beom's camp, which holds management control, and Youngpoong and MBK Partners, the largest shareholders, clashed head-on over the appointment of five directors. Seven candidates — Walter Field McLaren, Choi Yun-beom, and Hwang Deok-nam from Korea Zinc's side, and Park Byeong-uk, Choi Yeon-seok, Choi Byeong-il, and Lee Seon-suk from the Youngpoong/MBK side — appealed to shareholders for support. The cumulative voting system, voluntarily adopted last year, was applied at the meeting. Under cumulative voting, when electing two or more directors, shareholders are granted voting rights equal to the number of directors to be elected. Approximately 92.99 million votes were cast, resulting in the election of three candidates from Korea Zinc's side and two from the Youngpoong/MBK side. Notably, the vote difference between Chairman Choi Yun-beom (15,608,378 votes) and Director Hwang Deok-nam (15,608,288 votes) was a mere 90 votes, just 0.0001% of the total votes cast. (지난 3월24일 열린 고려아연의 정기주총. 경영권을 쥔 최윤범 회장 쪽과 최대주주인 영풍·엠비케이(MBK)파트너스 쪽이 이사 5명의 선임을 놓고 정면으로 충돌했다. 고려아연 쪽의 월터 필드 맥라렌·최윤범·황덕남 후보와 영풍·MBK 쪽의 박병욱·최연석·최병일·이선숙 후보 등 7명이 주주들에게 지지를 호소했다. 이날 주총에서는 지난해 자율적으로 도입한 집중투표제가 적용됐다. 집중투표제는 2인 이상 이사를 선임할 때 주주에게 이사 수만큼 의결권을 부여하는 제도다. 약 9299만3444개의 의결권이 행사됐는데, 고려아연 쪽 3명과 영풍·MBK 쪽 2명이 선임됐다. 그런데 최윤범 회장(1560만8378표)과 황덕남 이사(1560만8288표)의 표차가 단 90표로, 전체 의결권 대비 0.0001%에 불과했다.)

An institutional investor pointed out on the 19th, "It's inconceivable that Chairman Choi Yun-beom's side could have allocated votes strategically by candidate without prior knowledge of the advance voting (written and electronic) results from domestic and foreign institutional investors." Korea Zinc denied this, stating, "That is completely groundless. It was the result of Chairman Choi's side strategically allocating votes among candidates well." Chairman Choi Yun-beom's camp and the Youngpoong/MBK Partners camp will face off again in a proxy battle at the extraordinary shareholders' meeting on September 9 to elect one separately elected audit committee member and four independent directors. (한 기관투자자는 19일 “최윤범 회장 쪽이 국내외 기관투자자의 사전투표(서면·전자투표) 결과를 미리 알고, 후보별로 의결권을 맞춤형으로 배분하지 않고서는 있을 수 없는 일”이라고 지적했다. 이에 대해 고려아연은 “전혀 사실무근으로, 최 회장 쪽이 후보별 의결권 배분을 전략적으로 잘한 결과”라고 부인했다. 최윤범 회장 쪽과 영풍·MBK파트너스 쪽은 오는 9월9일 임시주총에서 분리선출 감사위원 1명과 독립이사 4명의 선임을 놓고 다시 한번 표대결을 벌인다.)

Following last year's amendment to the Commercial Act, cumulative voting will become mandatory for listed companies with assets of 2 trillion won or more, starting with director appointment agendas from September 10. The purpose is to allow minority shareholders to concentrate their votes on specific candidates, thereby checking the controlling shareholder's dominance over the board. However, there are significant concerns that if the controlling shareholder's practice of extracting early written and electronic voting results submitted by domestic and foreign institutional investors before the meeting — and using them to allocate votes in their favor — is not stopped, cumulative voting will become effectively meaningless. (지난해 상법 개정으로 자산 2조원 이상 상장회사는 오는 9월10일 이후 이사 선임 안건부터 집중투표제가 의무화한다. 소수주주도 특정 후보에 표를 몰아주는 방법으로, 지배주주의 이사회 독식을 견제할 수 있도록 하자는 게 취지이다. 하지만 국내외 기관투자자가 주총 전에 미리 제출한 서면·전자투표 결과를 지배주주가 미리 빼내 자신에게 유리하게 의결권을 배분하는 행위를 막지 못하면 집중투표제가 사실상 유명무실화할 것이라는 우려가 크다.)

For KOSPI-listed companies, domestic and foreign institutional investors hold an average of 50-60% of shares. Most of them do not attend shareholder meetings in person and exercise their voting rights through written or electronic voting. Written votes must be submitted to the company by mail three days before the meeting, while electronic voting is conducted online until 5 p.m. the day before the meeting. A serious 'information asymmetry' exists between the controlling shareholder and minority shareholders regarding written and electronic voting. The controlling shareholder can ascertain the voting results in advance and respond accordingly, while other shareholders vote 'blindly' — an inherently unequal structure. With the introduction of cumulative voting, this could become a decisive factor swaying director election outcomes. If several people take an exam but only one sees the answer sheet in advance, fairness is hardly to be expected. (코스피 상장사의 경우 국내외 기관투자자의 평균 지분은 50~60%에 달한다. 이들은 대부분 주총에 직접 참석하지 않고 서면·전자투표로 의결권을 행사한다. 서면투표는 주총 3일 전까지 우편으로 회사에 제출하고, 전자투표는 온라인을 이용해서 주총 하루 전 오후 5시까지 실시한다. 서면·전자투표 관련 지배주주와 소수주주 사이에는 심각한 ‘정보비대칭’이 존재한다. 지배주주는 주총 전에 투표 결과를 미리 파악해 대응할 수 있는 반면 나머지 주주는 ‘깜깜이’ 상태로 표를 행사하는 불평등한 구조이다. 집중투표제 도입 이후에는 이사 선임 결과를 좌우하는 결정적 변수가 될 수 있다. 여러명이 시험을 치르는데 한 사람만 미리 답안지를 본다면 공정성을 기대하기 힘들다.)

It is an open secret that companies holding shareholder meetings identify institutional investors who voted against company agendas in advance voting and then lobby or pressure them to change their votes to approval. One capital market insider said, "It's a long-standing practice in the capital markets for companies to review written and electronic voting results and then ask institutional investors who cast dissenting votes to switch to approval. Proxy solicitation firms have even emerged that collect proxies in favor of the company on its behalf." Another asset management firm official recounted, "There was even a case where an institutional investor changed its vote due to a company's request or pressure, and then, when other shareholders protested that they would challenge it legally, the investor changed its vote back to the original position." (주총 개최 기업이 사전투표에서 회사 안건에 반대한 기관투자자를 미리 파악해 찬성으로 바꾸도록 회유·압박하는 일은 공공연한 비밀이다. 한 자본시장 관계자는 “주총 회사가 서면·전자투표 결과를 본 뒤 반대표를 던진 기관투자자에게 찬성으로 바꿔달라고 요청하는 것은 자본시장의 오래된 관행”이라며 “아예 회사를 대신해 찬성 위임장을 받아주는 대행사까지 등장했다”고 말했다. 또 다른 자산운용사 관계자는 “기관투자가가 주총 회사의 요청·압박으로 투표 내용을 바꿨다가, 다른 주주들이 법적으로 문제 삼겠다고 반발하자, 다시 원안대로 재변경하는 일도 있었다”고 전했다.)

In a proposal for a 'Capital Markets Act Amendment' submitted to the Democratic Party of Korea's K-Capital Market Special Committee, the Korea Corporate Governance Forum (Chairman Lee Nam-woo) suggested a measure allowing other solicitors to demand that the issuer (the company holding the shareholders' meeting) provide access to (inspect or copy) advance voting results when soliciting proxy votes. Taiwan already discloses advance voting results one day before the shareholders' meeting. (한국기업거버넌스포럼(회장 이남우)은 더불어민주당 케이(K)-자본시장 특별위원회에 제출한 ‘자본시장법 개정안’ 제안에서, 발행인(주총 개최 기업)이 의결권 대리행사를 권유할 경우 다른 권유자가 발행인에게 사전투표 결과의 제공(열람·등사)을 요구할 수 있게 하는 방안을 건의했다. 대만은 주총 개최 하루 전에 사전투표 결과를 공개하고 있다.)

There are also calls to link this issue with the government's efforts to strengthen the implementation of the Stewardship Code (fiduciary duty principles), which is being pursued as a follow-up to the Commercial Act amendment. The Stewardship Code is a set of voluntary guidelines that major institutional investors, such as pension funds and asset management firms, should follow to faithfully manage clients' assets and enhance investment value by actively participating in the decision-making of investee companies — acting like a 'steward' managing a house on behalf of the owner. Critics point out that if the government demands faithful exercise of voting rights from institutional investors under the Stewardship Code while continuing to turn a blind eye to the leakage of advance voting results, the policy's effectiveness is unlikely to be achieved. (정부가 상법 개정의 후속 조처로 추진 중인 스튜어드십코드(수탁자 책임 원칙) 이행 내실화와 연계하는 방안도 제기된다. 스튜어드십 코드는 연기금, 자산운용사 등 주요 기관투자자가 주인의 부탁을 받아 집을 관리하는 ‘집사'처럼, 투자 대상 기업의 의사결정에 적극적으로 참여해 고객의 자산을 충실히 관리하고 투자 가치를 높이기 위해 지켜야 할 자율 지침이다. 정부가 스튜어드십코드 이행을 위해 기관투자자에 충실한 의결권 행사를 요구하면서 사전투표 유출 문제를 계속 방치한다면 정책의 실효성을 기대하기 힘들다는 지적이다.)

Oh Gi-hyeong, chairman of the K-Capital Market Special Committee, said, "During discussions on the Capital Markets Act amendment in the second half of the year, we will review two options: either completely prohibiting the sharing of advance voting results, or requiring that they be shared with all stakeholders." He added, "We could also consider a measure where, if institutional investors retroactively change their advance votes at the request of the company holding the meeting, this would be reflected in Stewardship Code implementation checks and evaluations, resulting in disadvantages when the National Pension Service allocates assets." The Stewardship Code Development Committee under the Korea ESG Standards Institute finalized the first revision of the code in late July and plans to begin reviewing and evaluating institutional investors' implementation of the code starting next year. The National Pension Service is also pushing to reflect the results of code implementation evaluations in its asset allocation for discretionary asset managers. (오기형 K-자본시장 특별위원장은 “하반기 자본시장법 개정안 논의 때 사전투표 결과를 아예 공유하지 못하도록 하거나, 모든 이해관계자가 공유하도록 하는 두가지 방안을 놓고 검토하겠다”며 “기관투자자들이 주총 개최 기업의 요청으로 사전투표 결과를 사후적으로 변경할 경우 스튜어드십코드 이행 점검·평가에 반영해서 국민연금이 자산배분을 할 때 불이익을 주는 방안도 생각할 수 있다”고 말했다. 한국이에스지(ESG)기준원 산하 스튜어드십코드 발전위원회는 지난 7월말 1차 코드 개정안을 확정하고, 내년부터 기관투자자의 코드 이행을 점검·평가하기로 했다. 국민연금도 코드 이행 평가 결과를 위탁운용사의 자산배분에 반영하는 방안을 추진 중이다.)

Kwak Jung-soo, Senior Correspondent, Hankyoreh Economics & Society Research Institute, jskwak@hani.co.kr (곽정수 한겨레경제사회연구원 선임기자 jskwak@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Dear, shall we get a 'robot' for your father's place?"... The Chuseok gift landscape has changed (“여보, 아버님 댁에 ‘로봇’ 놓아드릴까”…추석 선물 풍경 달라졌네)
item.description:
Ahead of the Chuseok holiday, the retail industry is competing by rolling out differentiated gift sets one after another. (추석 명절을 앞두고 유통업계가 차별화된 선물 세트를 잇달아 선보이며 경쟁에 나섰다.)

According to a summary of the retail industry on the 19th, in preparation for Chuseok, the hotel industry has bet on premium gourmet and experience-based products, while the convenience store industry is targeting the market with novelty robots and popular character merchandise. Large discount stores are leveraging large-scale discounts and value-for-money products to target cost-conscious demand. (19일 유통업계 설명을 종합하면, 추석을 대비해 호텔업계는 프리미엄 미식과 체험형 상품으로 승부수를 띄웠고 편의점업계는 이색 로봇과 인기 캐릭터 상품으로 시장 공략에 나섰다. 대형마트는 대규모 할인과 실속형 상품을 앞세워 가성비 수요를 겨냥하고 있다.)

What stands out is the convenience store industry. It is seeking to expand into a comprehensive holiday gift platform based on unique products and practicality. CU and GS25 have staked their bets on cutting-edge devices and tangible assets. GS25 has released a humanoid robot priced in the 5 million won range, vintage wines in the 9 million won range, a gold medal commemorating independence activist Ahn Jung-geun, and silver and bronze medals featuring artist Lee Jung-seop. CU has prepared a humanoid robot priced in the 30 million won range, 12 types of pure gold bars, and Pokémon character merchandise targeting all age groups. Seven-Eleven has tapped into the "small luxury" demand with Hello Kitty goods and desserts created in collaboration with hotels. Emart24, along with department store-grade fresh food, has introduced small-packaged hanwoo beef sets for so-called "solo holiday revelers" who spend the holiday alone, and gold bars commemorating the Year of the Red Horse. (눈에 띄는 것은 편의점업계다. 이색 상품과 실용성을 바탕으로 종합 명절 선물 플랫폼으로의 확장을 꾀하는 모습이다. 씨유(CU)와 지에스(GS)25는 첨단 기기와 실물 자산으로 승부수를 띄웠다. 지에스25는 500만원대 휴머노이드 로봇과 900만원대 빈티지 와인, 안중근 의사 기념 금메달 및 이중섭 은·동메달을 내놨다. 씨유는 3천만원대 휴머노이드 로봇과 순금 골드바 12종을 비롯해 전 연령층을 겨냥한 포켓몬 캐릭터 상품을 준비했다. 세븐일레븐은 헬로키티 굿즈와 호텔 협업 디저트로 ‘스몰 럭셔리’ 수요를 파고들었다. 이마트24는 백화점급 신선식품과 함께 혼자 명절을 보내는 이른바 ‘혼명절족’을 위한 소포장 한우 세트, 붉은 말의 해 기념 골드바를 선보였다.)

The hotel industry is going after premium demand. Hotel Shilla is focusing on gourmet products. A representative example is its sets featuring rare wines and whiskeys exclusively imported and selected by the head sommelier, organic groceries, and desserts from its own bakery. Josun Hotels & Resorts has strengthened its premium lineup with "Jang Man-soon's Samsam-ga Uibo," a health food created in collaboration with a master of nacre lacquerware, exclusive premium wine sets, and signature kimchi and abalone paste. Kensington Hotels & Resorts has sought to differentiate itself with "experience-based products" such as accommodation vouchers and dining certificates for restaurants in Yeouido. (호텔업계는 프리미엄 수요 공략에 나섰다. 호텔신라는 미식 상품에 집중하고 있다. 헤드 소믈리에가 엄선한 단독 수입 희귀 와인과 위스키, 유기농 식료품 및 자체 베이커리 디저트를 담은 세트를 선보인 것이 대표적이다. 조선호텔앤리조트는 나전칠기 명장 협업 건강식품 ‘장만순 산삼가 공의보’, 단독 프리미엄 와인 세트, 시그니처 김치·전복장 등 고급 상품 라인업을 강화했다. 켄싱턴호텔앤리조트는 숙박권과 여의도 레스토랑 식사권 등 ‘경험형 상품’으로 차별화를 꾀했다.)

Large discount stores are pursuing a strategy that encompasses both value and premium offerings. Emart is leading with discounts of up to 50%, offering a wide range from wines and dried yellow corvina priced between 20,000 and 40,000 won to premium whiskeys in the 800,000 won range. Lotte Mart is aggressively targeting demand for practical gifts by greatly expanding fruit sets in the 40,000 to 60,000 won range, seaweed and nut sets under 50,000 won, and livestock products under 100,000 won. (대형마트는 가성비와 프리미엄을 아우르는 전략을 펼치고 있다. 이마트는 최대 50% 할인 혜택을 앞세워 2만~4만원대 와인과 굴비부터 80만원대 고급 위스키까지 폭넓은 상품군을 선보인다. 롯데마트는 4만~6만원대 과일, 5만원 미만 김·견과 세트와 10만원 미만 축산 상품을 대폭 확대하며 실속형 선물 수요를 적극적으로 공략한다.)

Lee Ju-bin, Reporter yes@hani.co.kr (이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Woori Bank donates 100 million won to mark 100th birthday of Park Kyongni... "Former commercial bank teller" (우리은행, 박경리 탄생 100주년 맞아 1억 기부…“상업은행 은행원 출신”)
item.description:
Woori Bank has decided to sponsor the English translation of "Toji" to commemorate the 100th birthday of Park Kyongni. (우리은행이 박경리 선생의 탄생 100주년을 기념해 ‘토지’ 영문 번역을 후원하기로 했다.)

Woori Bank announced on the 19th that it signed a business agreement with the Toji Cultural Foundation to mark the 100th birthday of Park Kyongni and donated 100 million won. Before her literary debut, Park worked as a bank teller at the Yongsan branch of Commercial Bank, the predecessor of Woori Bank, in 1954, establishing a connection with Woori Bank. She also contributed the long poem "The Sea and the Sky" and the short story "The Records of Previous Lives" to the Commercial Bank in-house magazine "Cheonil." (우리은행은 박경리 선생 탄생 100주년을 맞아 토지문화재단과 업무협약을 체결하고 기부금 1억원을 전달했다고 19일 밝혔다. 박 선생은 등단 전인 1954년 우리은행의 전신인 상업은행 용산지점에서 은행원으로 근무하며 우리은행과 인연을 맺은 바 있다. 상업은행 사보 ‘천일’에 장편시 ‘바다와 하늘’, 단편소설 ‘전생록’을 기고하기도 했다.)

The donation will be used for the English translation and publication of Park's representative novel "Toji." The aim is to help "Toji" reach readers around the world. The English translation of Part 1 of "Toji" was first published in the UK in the 1990s, but translation work on Parts 2 through 5 has been slow. In addition, the Park Kyongni Literary Prize, organized by the Toji Cultural Foundation, will award a special prize this year to an individual who has contributed to the development and dissemination of Korean literature. (기부금은 박 선생의 대표 소설 ‘토지’의 영문 번역과 출판 사업에 쓰인다. ‘토지’가 전 세계 독자와 만날 수 있도록 돕는다는 취지다. ‘토지’ 1부 영문 번역본은 1990년대 영국에서 처음 출판됐으나, 2~5부 번역 작업은 더딘 상황이다. 아울러 토지문화재단이 주관하는 박경리문학상에서는 올해 한국 문학 발전과 확산에 기여한 인물에게 특별상을 주기로 했다.)

A "Park Kyongni Special Exhibition" will also be held. At "Woori 1899," the history hall at Woori Bank's headquarters, works that Park published in the Commercial Bank in-house magazine and her personal collections will be on display. The exhibition runs until the 18th of next month, and admission is free. (‘박경리 특별 기획전’도 진행한다. 우리은행 본점에 있는 역사관 ‘우리1899’에서 박 선생이 상업은행 사보에 발표했던 작품과 개인 소장품을 선보인다. 기획전은 다음달 18일까지 진행되며 관람은 무료다.)

Lee Jae-yeon Reporter jay@hani.co.kr (이재연 기자 jay@hani.co.kr)

item.title: “ESG is an economic issue, not a moral one”... How Amundi is changing companies (“ESG는 도덕 아니라 경제 문제”…‘아문디’가 기업을 바꾸는 법)
item.description:
Korea’s stewardship code was revised for the first time since its enactment 10 years ago, at the end of last July. The code contains a pledge by institutional investors to monitor and engage with investee companies as “stewards” of other people’s money, but at home it has faced constant criticism that it has amounted to nothing more than ritualistic proxy voting. Amundi, Europe’s largest asset manager with more than 2 trillion euros (approximately 3,200 trillion won) in assets under management, is widely regarded as the most systematic practitioner of this “stewardship” role. On June 25, we met with Caroline Le Mo, Group Head of ESG Research and Voting Policy, and Elodie Lauzel, Head of Responsible Investment, at Amundi’s Paris headquarters. The Amundi approach confirmed in the interview offers three implications for Korea’s revision discussions. <<> First, the principle that shareholder engagement is about “economics,” not “ethics.” When Amundi makes demands of companies, it first weighs whether the issue has a real impact on corporate value—that is, its “economic materiality.” Because it approaches from the perspective of sustainable profitability rather than moral judgment, it has not changed a single word of its policy amid the U.S.-led ESG backlash. This stands in contrast to the way shareholder activism by Korean institutional investors often gets trapped in political debates over “pension socialism” or “management interference.” <<> Second, sophisticated rules disclosed in advance. Amundi analyzes general meeting agendas using a pre-established “decision tree” and applies a step-by-step escalation procedure that runs from dialogue → votes against → ESG rating downgrades → investment exclusion. Because the criteria for casting against votes are transparently disclosed, there is no room for accusations of arbitrary intervention targeting individual companies. This is a point worth noting for the Korean market, where the National Pension Service’s proxy voting repeatedly gets embroiled in “rubber stamp” or “state control” controversies. <<> Third, 100% proxy voting with no exceptions. Amundi votes on all shares it holds, regardless of whether they are in active or passive funds. Last year, it cast votes on 100% of the 168 stocks in its Korean portfolio. The logic is that passive funds, which cannot sell and exit, have voting rights as their only lever. Owner-family-controlled Korean and Japanese companies are also no reason to give up engagement. For companies with controlling shareholders, Amundi applies differentiated standards for board independence demands, creating realistic criteria and continuing the dialogue. <<> The following is a question-and-answer session. <<> ―The backlash against ESG is strong in the United States and elsewhere. Has Amundi’s policy changed at all? <<> (Caroline Le Mo) “Not at all. Amundi’s position is clear. When conducting shareholder engagement, we first assess whether the topic has ‘economic materiality.’ Our demands stem not from moral value judgments but solely from the perspective of economic sustainability. In our experience, there isn’t really substantial pushback from U.S. companies either. That said, the way people talk has definitely become more cautious. European companies with large U.S. exposure have also grown more careful in their public statements. But beneath the surface-level language, companies continue to do what needs to be done. If the past was a cycle focused on ‘announcements,’ we are now in a cycle focused on ‘implementation.’ More important than the U.S. political phenomenon is this transition into the actual implementation phase.” <<> ―When engaging with Korean and Japanese companies where founding families hold controlling stakes, do you take a different approach than with European companies with dispersed ownership? <<> (Caroline Le Mo) “We take a pragmatic approach. The way we engage varies depending on the company’s situation. Owner-family governance structures are a relatively less sensitive issue for us because our voting policy already accounts for those specific circumstances. Where a particular shareholder controls the company versus where ownership is fully dispersed in the market, the standards we demand—such as board independence ratios—necessarily differ, and we apply them in a differentiated manner. <<> Last year we voted on 100% of the shares in 168 Korean portfolio companies. It is true that engagement with Korean companies is somewhat more challenging than in other Asian countries. But this is a matter of the ‘learning curve’ that all countries adopting new systems go through. Companies are defensive at first, but once they realize that this dialogue and change ultimately increase their own value, communication becomes much smoother.” <<> ―What are the internal criteria and procedures for casting votes against management? <<> (Caroline Le Mo) “Amundi has its own proxy voting policy with very precise rules. When a company presents multiple agenda items, we analyze them against a sophisticated pre-established ‘decision tree.’ Within this framework, we use an ‘escalation’ approach, gradually raising the level of response to drive behavioral change in companies, and we make active use of voting rights. We express our vision from the E, S, and G perspectives through votes against. <<> There are two reasons for raising the level. First, when a company lags behind its peers or is at the center of major controversy. Second, when our engagement activities have ended in negative outcomes. That said, not every negative outcome triggers an escalation. It only happens for very significant or sufficiently mature issues. If it’s a newly initiated topic, we may wait longer before escalating.” <<> ―How often does failed engagement lead to investment exclusion? <<> (Caroline Le Mo) “It is difficult to give an exact percentage. There are two pathways for escalation. One is casting against votes at shareholder meetings; the other is downgrading the issuer’s ESG rating. When a rating is downgraded, it acts as a kind of ‘penalty’ in portfolio construction, making it harder for fund managers to invest in that company.” <<> (Elodie Lauzel) “Final investment exclusion is certainly possible, but it is, and remains, the last resort. Our real intent is to use multiple levers before reaching exclusion so that engagement with companies works and moves them one step forward.” <<> ―Do you also actively engage with companies held in passive index funds that you cannot sell and exit? <<> (Caroline Le Mo) “Amundi operates a centralized voting and engagement policy. We do not distinguish by fund type (active or passive) or product type (equity or fixed income). We engage with the ‘issuing company,’ not with the investment vehicle. We engage equally with companies held in passive funds. Even if we cannot sell, we can still exert influence through voting rights. In fact, through our passive holdings, we filed a shareholder proposal at a Japanese power company that had been excluded from active management, and in 2024 that company announced the closure of five coal-fired power units, attributing this directly to shareholder engagement. Amundi has set a principle of voting on 100% of shares across all strategies and all products.” <<> ―How do you engage with issuers when investing in bonds, where you have no voting rights? <<> (Caroline Le Mo) “In two ways. First, we engage directly with the issuing company itself. Second, when green bonds, social bonds, or sustainability bonds are issued, we scrutinize the quality of the proceeds and the sustainability strategy through dialogue. For sovereign bonds, we also engage on the country’s strategy and the sustainability of the instrument.” <<> (Elodie Lauzel) “Companies that issue bonds are usually also listed on equity markets. And to issue bonds successfully, they need large anchor investors to buy them. Even without voting rights on bonds, this creates an incentive for companies to engage in sustainability dialogue with major institutional investors like Amundi.” <<> ―Amundi links its own executives’ compensation to ESG targets. Do you demand the same of investee companies? <<> “The inclusion of ESG factors in CEO compensation—especially performance-linked pay—is very important to us, and we require it across our investee companies. For companies outside Europe, the level of our demands may still be lower, but the importance is the same. In Korea, there are not many compensation-related agenda items at shareholder meetings, but we still demand it, and we may vote against if executive pay disclosure is too opaque.” <<> ―There is criticism of “engagement washing”—that shareholder engagement is just for show without real change. How do you measure and demonstrate the effectiveness of your activities? <<> (Caroline Le Mo) “First, let me clarify that Amundi is an asset manager, not an asset owner. The money we manage belongs entirely to third-party clients, and our first duty is to faithfully fulfill what clients have entrusted and requested. Our voting policy contains transparent, clear criteria on when we cast against votes. For example, on climate strategy, the moment a company’s proposal falls short of the Paris Agreement’s ‘well below 2°C, aiming for 1.5°C’ threshold, we cast a against vote without exception. We apply this standard without wavering, and we disclose every step of the process transparently to clients—because it is their money. <<> That said, we cannot conclusively prove that a particular company’s positive change was solely due to Amundi. Corporate change is the result of many interacting causes, and we participate as one member of the ecosystem driving that change. The reason we publish extensive shareholder engagement reports every year is to transparently show the market the momentum and concrete cases of how companies are moving. It is not to claim improvement results as our own credit. The key is for each of us to do our part so that the entire system moves in the right direction.” <<> (Elodie Lauzel) “On the single topic of climate change alone, Amundi has engaged with 1,700 companies over several years. We are witnessing clear change on the ground. We see companies reducing or halting coal-fired capacity, and establishing and implementing concrete carbon neutrality strategies. The key is to set clear goals, disclose them transparently, and never give up realistic yet ambitious dialogue. If we cut off dialogue with companies because we are afraid of criticism, we only end up shifting responsibility for solving problems onto others and leaving them unaddressed.” <<> ―What led Amundi to place responsible investment and stewardship at the center of its investment philosophy? <<> (Elodie Lauzel) “For Amundi, ESG is by no means a logic of chasing temporary trends. It is very systematically tied to the company’s identity. We had dedicated teams from the very beginning, and have since set transition targets through three ‘Ambition Plans.’ The core is integrating ESG into actual investments while equally integrating it into our role as shareholders—shareholder engagement and proxy voting. To that end, we have given employees and managers clear targets and aligned them through internal training. As a result, about half of all shareholder engagement activities Amundi has completed end with positive outcomes. That is because we engage with patience and sincerity, and we make ‘feasible demands’ that companies can accept, grounded in best practices already proven elsewhere.” <<> Paris/Text and photos by Lee Bong-hyun, Research Fellow, ESG Center, Hankyoreh Institute of Economic and Social Research bhlee@hani.co.kr (한국의 스튜어드십 코드가 제정 10년 만에 지난 7월 말 처음 개정됐다. 기관투자자가 ‘남의 돈을 맡은 집사(스튜어드)’로서 투자 기업을 살피고 대화하겠다는 약속이 코드에 담겼지만, 그간 국내에서는 형식적 의결권 행사에 그친다는 지적이 끊이지 않았다. 운용자산 2조유로(약 3200조원)가 넘는 유럽 최대 자산운용사 아문디는 이 ‘집사 노릇’을 가장 체계적으로 하는 곳으로 꼽힌다. 지난 6월25일 프랑스 파리 아문디 본사에서 캐롤린 르 모 그룹 이에스지(ESG) 연구·의결권 총괄과 엘로디 로젤 책임투자 총괄을 만났다. 인터뷰에서 확인한 아문디의 방식은 한국의 개정 논의에 세 가지 시사점을 던진다.)

item.title: [Breaking] SK Hynix to Buy Back and Cancel 40 Trillion Won Worth of Treasury Shares… Considering Dividend Expansion ([속보] SK하이닉스, 40조원 규모 자사주 매입·소각…배당 확대 검토)
item.description:
SK Hynix announced on the 19th that its board of directors decided to newly acquire and cancel treasury shares worth 40 trillion and 4.34 billion won. The company aims to buy back and cancel 3.3% of its total issued shares (730,492,365 shares) to enhance shareholder value. (에스케이(SK)하이닉스는 19일 이사회를 열고 40조43억4천만원 규모 자사주(기업이 취득하는 자기주식) 신규 취득 및 소각을 결정했다고 공시했다. 주주 가치 제고를 위해 전체 발행 주식 총수(7억3049만2365주)의 3.3%를 매입·소각하겠다는 것이다.)

The number of shares planned for acquisition through open-market purchases is 24.07 million shares, with the expected acquisition period running from the 20th of this month to November 19th of this year. The planned number of shares to be acquired was set based on the previous day's closing price (1.662 million won per share), and the scale of shares acquired may vary depending on future stock price fluctuations. (장내 매수를 통한 취득 예정 주식 수는 2407만주, 취득 예상 기간은 이달 20일부터 오는 11월19일까지다. 취득 예정 주식 수는 전날 종가(주당 166만2천원)을 기준으로 정한 것으로, 향후 주가 변동에 따라 취득 주식 규모는 달라질 수 있다.)

Additionally, the company stated that it will return at least 50% of the cumulative free cash flow (FCF) generated during the implementation period of its existing shareholder return policy (2025–2027) to shareholders through treasury share acquisitions and cancellations and cash dividends. Previously, it had said it would "return to shareholders using 50% of FCF as a resource," but going forward, it will increase the scale of shareholder returns to "50% or more." (또 회사 쪽은 기존에 수립한 주주 환원 정책의 이행 기간(2025∼2027년)에 발생하는 누적 잉여현금흐름(FCF)의 50% 이상을 자사주 취득·소각, 현금 배당을 통해 주주들에게 환원하겠다고 밝혔다. 지금까지는 “잉여현금흐름의 50%를 재원으로 주주 환원을 하겠다”고 했으나, 앞으로는 주주 환원 규모를 ‘50% 이상’으로 늘리겠다는 것이다.)

To this end, it plans to review measures to expand dividends, including existing fixed dividends and special dividends, and will continue additional treasury share acquisitions and cancellations until next year, taking into account cash flow, market conditions, and distributable profits. SK Hynix said, "Specific details on the additional scale and method of returns, including dividends and share buybacks, will be announced at the time of the third-quarter (July–September) earnings release this year, following board resolutions." (이를 위해 기존 고정 배당과 특별 배당 등을 포함한 배당 확대 방안을 검토하고, 향후에도 현금 흐름·시장 상황·배당가능이익 등을 고려해 내년까지 추가 자사주 취득·소각을 지속할 계획이라고 설명했다. 에스케이하이닉스는 “배당과 자사주 매입을 포함한 구체적인 추가 환원 규모와 방식은 이사회 결의를 거쳐 올해 3분기(7∼9월) 실적 발표 시점에 안내할 예정”이라고 했다.)

Reporter Park Jong-oh pjo2@hani.co.kr (박종오 기자 pjo2@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Homeplus Returns… Banking on ‘690-Won Crabs and 4,990-Won Eggs’ to Solidify Box-Office Momentum (홈플러스의 귀환…‘690원 꽃게·4990원 계란’ 앞세워 흥행 돌풍 굳히기)
item.description:
Homeplus, which succeeded in drawing large crowds in the early days of its reopening with events like half-price Korean beef discounts, is now launching a special sale under the theme of customer appreciation to cement its sales recovery. As aggressive discount-driven promotions continue, whether the retailer can address structural normalization challenges—such as securing financial soundness and rebuilding supplier trust—is seen as the key to its turnaround. (한우 반값 할인 행사 등으로 재개장 초기 대규모 집객에 성공한 홈플러스가 고객 감사 명목의 특가 행사를 열고 매출 회복세 굳히기에 나선다. 파격적인 할인 중심의 판촉이 이어지는 가운데, 재무 건전성 확보와 납품업체 신뢰 회복 등 구조적 정상화 과제를 해결할 수 있을지가 회생의 관건으로 꼽힌다.)

Homeplus announced on the 19th that it will hold a massive special sale event called “Homeplus is Back” to reward customers who returned to its stores. After posting total sales of 43.7 billion won over five days since reopening last week and seeing customer visits surge 74% compared to before the suspension of operations, the company aims to sustain its customer-drawing momentum with striking discounts on food items. (홈플러스는 매장을 다시 찾아준 고객들에게 보답하기 위해 대규모 특가 행사인 ‘홈플 is Back’을 진행한다고 19일 밝혔다. 지난주 재개장 이후 닷새 동안 총매출 437억원을 기록하고 영업 중단 전 대비 74% 늘어난 고객이 방문하는 등 초기 흥행을 거두자, 파격적인 먹거리 할인을 앞세워 집객 효과를 이어가겠다는 전략이다.)

The event will feature steep discounts on in-season fresh foods and meat and seafood products. From the 21st to the 23rd, over three days, this year’s first autumn crabs, “cold-water shock stunned crabs,” will be sold at 690 won per 100 grams, while U.S.-sourced white fresh eggs (30-count) will be priced at 4,990 won, limited to two cartons per person. My Homeplus membership holders will also receive a 5,000-won discount on all fruit items, including grapes, apples, peaches, and kiwis. (이번 행사에서는 제철 신선식품과 축·수산물을 대폭 할인해 선보인다. 오는 21일부터 23일까지 사흘간 올해 첫 가을 햇꽃게인 ‘냉수마찰 기절 꽃게’를 100g당 690원에 판매하고, 미국산 백색 신선란 30구를 4990원에 1인 2판 한정 판매한다. 마이홈플러스 멤버십 회원에게는 포도·사과·복숭아·키위 등 과일 전 품목에 5천원 할인 혜택을 제공한다.)

Discounts on meat and seafood have also been prepared. “Okmokdwaeji frozen pork belly” will be 50% off, with U.S. beef flanken ribs at 50% off on the 21st and Korean beef grade 2 sirloin and striploin at half price on the 22nd. Four types of fresh marinated meat will be 40% off, and from the 20th to the 21st, “Healthy Garlic-Infused Jeongdaun Smoked Duck” will be sold as a 1+1 offer. Additionally, Norwegian fresh salmon will be 40% off, fresh squid and Jeju fresh hairtail 50% off, and “Dangdang Two-Piece Old-Style Fried Chicken” will be sold for 9,990 won, with discounts of up to 50% and 1+1 deals across a broad range of major processed and fresh foods. (육류와 수산물 할인도 마련됐다. ‘옥먹돼 꽁꽁 냉동 삼겹살’을 50% 할인하며, 21일 미국산 갈빗살 50%, 22일 한우 2등급 등심·채끝 50% 반값 판매를 차례로 진행한다. 생생 양념육 4종은 40% 할인하고, 20~21일 이틀간 ‘건강한 마늘담은 정다운 훈제오리’를 1+1으로 판매한다. 이 밖에도 노르웨이 생연어 40%, 생물 오징어와 제주 생물갈치 50% 할인, ‘당당 두마리옛날통닭’ 9990원 판매 등 주요 가공·신선식품 전반에 걸쳐 최대 50% 할인 및 1+1 행사를 펼친다.)

A Homeplus official said, “To repay the customers who have shown us the possibility of normalization, we will continue to offer quality products at affordable prices.” (홈플러스 관계자는 “정상화 가능성을 보여준 고객들께 보답하기 위해 앞으로도 좋은 상품을 부담 없는 가격으로 제공할 것”이라고 전했다.)

However, industry observers view the risks of deteriorating profitability after the initial discount rush and supplier trust issues stemming from unsettled payments as ongoing concerns. Ahead of the creditors’ meeting scheduled for the 2nd of next month at the Seoul Bankruptcy Court, whether Homeplus can prove genuine self-sustainability beyond merely drawing crowds is expected to be the decisive factor. (다만 업계에서는 초반 할인 특수 이후 수익성 악화와 미정산에 따른 납품업체 신뢰 문제를 여전한 위험 요소로 보고 있다. 다음달 2일 예정된 서울회생법원 관계인집회를 앞두고, 홈플러스가 단순 집객을 넘어 실질적인 자생력을 입증할 수 있을지가 관건이 될 전망이다.)

Lee Ju-bin Reporter yes@hani.co.kr (이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Homeplus Sees Reopening Success, but 800 Billion Won in Debt Takes a Backseat? Suppliers File Statement with Court (‘재개장 흥행’ 홈플러스, 8천억 외상값은 뒷전?…납품업체들 법원에 의견서)
item.description:
Suppliers who delivered goods to Homeplus but have not been paid have submitted a statement to the court, demanding a concrete repayment plan for public-interest claims. They point out that while Homeplus has drawn crowds with around 40 billion won in sales within five days of reopening, repayment of the overdue amounts owed to the partners who have kept its shelves stocked has been pushed to the back burner. (홈플러스에 납품하고도 대금을 받지 못한 업체들이 법원에 의견서를 내고 공익채권에 대한 구체적인 변제 계획을 세워달라고 요구했다. 최근 홈플러스가 재개장 닷새 만에 400억원대 매출을 올리며 흥행을 이어가고 있지만, 정작 그동안 매대를 지켜온 협력사들의 밀린 대금 변제는 뒷전으로 밀리고 있다는 것이 이들의 지적이다.)

Law firm LKB Pyeongsan, representing the "Homeplus Trade Public-Interest Claimants' Council," announced on the 19th that it submitted an official statement to the Seoul Bankruptcy Court on the 18th. The council is made up of companies that supplied goods after Homeplus filed for rehabilitation proceedings in March last year but have yet to receive payment. (‘홈플러스 상거래 공익채권단 협의회’ 대리인인 법무법인 엘케이비(LKB)평산은 지난 18일 서울회생법원에 공식 의견서를 제출했다고 19일 밝혔다. 협의회는 홈플러스가 지난해 3월 회생절차 개시를 신청한 뒤 납품을 하고도 대금을 받지 못한 업체들로 꾸려졌다.)

The council's core demand is that the rehabilitation plan include a clear schedule for when and with what funds the roughly 800 billion won in overdue supply payments will be settled. Homeplus's unpaid trade public-interest claims owed to suppliers stood at approximately 793.9 billion won as of the end of May. (협의회의 핵심 요구는 8천억원에 이르는 밀린 납품대금을 언제, 어떤 돈으로 갚을지 명확한 일정을 회생계획안에 담아달라는 것이다. 홈플러스가 갚지 못한 납품업체 상거래 공익채권은 지난 5월 말 기준 약 7939억원에 이른다.)

Under current law, "public-interest claims" such as product payments arising during rehabilitation proceedings must be repaid promptly and ahead of ordinary debts. The intent is that counterparties who continue supplying goods to a rehabilitated company must be strongly protected to sustain the rehabilitation system itself. However, the council criticized that Homeplus's rehabilitation plan details a 10-year repayment schedule for rehabilitation debts—ordinary obligations—while offering only vague language for public-interest claims, which are supposed to take priority, stating they would be "repaid from time to time with operating revenue and other resources." (현행법상 회생절차 중에 발생한 물품대금 같은 ‘공익채권’은 일반 빚보다 먼저, 수시로 갚아야 한다. 회생기업에 공급을 계속한 상대방을 두텁게 보호해야 회생제도가 유지될 수 있다는 취지다. 하지만 협의회 쪽은 홈플러스의 회생계획안이 일반 빚인 회생채권에는 10년 치 변제계획을 상세히 제시한 반면, 우선 변제 대상인 공익채권에는 “영업수익금과 기타 재원으로 수시 변제한다”는 수준의 모호한 내용만 담았다고 비판했다.)

Questions of fairness have also been raised over the use of recently injected emergency funds. Earlier this month, Homeplus borrowed 200 billion won in debtor-in-possession (DIP) emergency operating funds from Meritz Financial Group, using them for store reopenings, purchasing new products, and paying overdue employee wages and severance. The council acknowledges the need to buy new goods and protect worker wages but points out that no funds have been allocated to settle the arrears owed to existing suppliers who have trusted the company and delivered goods over time. (최근 수혈된 긴급자금의 사용처를 두고도 형평성 문제가 제기됐다. 홈플러스는 이달 초 메리츠금융그룹에서 긴급운영자금(DIP) 2천억원을 대출받아 점포 재개장과 신규 상품 매입, 밀린 직원 임금·퇴직금 지급 등에 썼다. 이에 대해 협의회는 신규 물품 매입이나 노동자 임금 보호의 필요성은 인정하지만, 과거부터 회사를 믿고 물건을 공급해 온 기존 납품업체들의 외상값 변제에는 자금이 배분되지 않고 있다고 지적했다.)

The council stressed that "the approximately 790 billion won worth of products supplied by these companies have likely already been sold in stores and converted into cash," demanding that Homeplus account for the use of those sales proceeds and allocate part of the emergency operating funds to repay existing receivables. The council and its legal representatives stated, "We plan to request an opportunity to present our views during the upcoming review of the rehabilitation plan, while also pursuing a full-scale response, including appeals to the government and National Assembly and, if necessary, civil and criminal legal action." The deadline for approving Homeplus's rehabilitation plan is the 4th of next month. (협의회는 “납품업체들이 공급한 약 7900억원 상당의 상품은 이미 매장에서 팔려 현금화됐을 것”이라며 해당 판매대금의 사용처를 소명하고, 긴급운영자금 중 일부를 기존 미수금 변제에 써야 한다고 강조했다. 협의회와 대리인단은 “앞으로 회생계획안 심리 과정에서 의견 진술 기회를 요청하는 한편, 정부·국회 건의와 필요시 민·형사상 법적 대응을 포함한 전방위 대응에 나설 방침”이라고 밝혔다. 홈플러스 회생계획안 가결 시한은 다음 달 4일이다.)

Reporter Lee Ju-bin yes@hani.co.kr (이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Won-dollar exchange rate drops to 1,300 range for first time in 11 months... Kospi plunges 5% to 6,471 (환율 11개월 만에 1300원대로↓…코스피 5% 급락해 6471)
item.description:
The won-dollar exchange rate has fallen to the 1,300 won range for the first time in 11 months. This is an unusual situation where the Korean won is strengthening even as long-term U.S. Treasury yields surge. The move is largely attributed to a flood of dollar selling by domestic export companies. Instead, it was the stock market that took the direct hit from rising interest rates. The Kospi, which had risen for all five sessions last week, fell more than 5%, sinking back below the 6,500 mark. (원-달러 환율이 11개월 만에 1300원대로 떨어졌다. 미 국채 장기금리가 치솟는 상황에서 원화 가치가 오히려 오르는 이례적인 상황이다. 국내 수출기업의 달러화 매도 물량이 쏟아진 데 따른 영향이 큰 것으로 풀이된다. 대신 금리 상승의 직격타를 맞은 것은 주식시장이었다. 지난주 5일 내내 상승했던 코스피는 5% 이상 떨어지며 6500선 밑으로 다시 주저앉았다.)

On the Seoul foreign exchange market on the 19th, the won-dollar exchange rate closed at 1,397.7 won, down 14.1 won from the previous day's onshore trading close (3:30 p.m.). It is the first time in 11 months—since September 29 of last year (1,398.7 won)—that the onshore closing rate has fallen below the 1,400 won level. (19일 서울 외환시장에서 원-달러 환율은 전날 주간거래(오후 3시30분) 종가보다 14.1원 내린 1397.7원에 거래를 마쳤다. 주간거래 종가 기준 원-달러 환율이 1400원 아래로 내려간 것은 지난해 9월29일(1398.7원) 이후 11개월 만에 처음이다.)

The exchange rate, which had been hovering in the mid-1,500 won range until early last month, has recently been on a downward trend, sparked by the large-scale inflow of dollars into Korea from SK Hynix's listing of American depositary receipts (ADRs) on the U.S. Nasdaq. As the exchange rate fell to the mid-to-late 1,400 won range, export companies that had been holding dollars for investments in the U.S. and other purposes reportedly began bringing dollars back home in a chain reaction, worried about exchange losses. Despite the financial market turmoil caused by rising long-term U.S. Treasury yields (10-year and 30-year), the domestic dollar supply-demand dynamics are driving the won's strength (fall in the exchange rate). The rise in U.S. Treasury yields stems from concerns over the U.S. fiscal deficit, and the fact that the dollar has not strengthened despite higher yields is also seen as a contributing factor. Park Hyung-jung, an economist at Woori Bank, analyzed, "This is an unprecedented exchange rate movement, where changes in international financial markets have had little impact and the correlation with the yen has weakened considerably." (지난달 초까지 1500원대 중반을 넘나들던 환율이 최근 하락세를 이어오게 된 계기는 에스케이(SK)하이닉스가 미국 나스닥에 주식예탁증서(ADR)를 상장하며 조달한 달러가 국내로 대규모 유입되고 있다는 점이다. 이로 인해 환율이 1400원대 중후반으로 떨어지자 그동안 대미투자 등을 위해 달러를 보유하고 있던 수출기업들이 환차손 등을 우려하며 덩달아 달러를 들여오는 연쇄작용이 발생한 것으로 풀이된다. 미 국채 장기금리(10년물·30년물)가 계속 오르며 금융시장이 불안한 상황이지만, 이러한 국내 달러 수급 요인으로 원화가 강세(환율 하락)를 보인다는 것이다. 미 국채금리 상승이 미 재정 적자에 대한 우려에서 기인한 만큼 금리 상승에도 달러가 강세를 띠지 못한 것도 영향을 끼친 것으로 풀이된다. 박형중 우리은행 이코노미스트는 “국제 금융시장의 변화가 큰 영향을 미치지 않고 엔화 동조도 상당히 약해진, 과거 보지 못했던 환율 움직임”이라고 분석했다.)

However, some point out that since companies cannot continue selling dollars indefinitely, the trend in late this month bears watching. Choi Kwang-hyuk, a researcher at LS Securities, said in a recent report, "We are at a point where the momentum for maintaining the downtrend is weakening." Kim Dae-jun, a researcher at Korea Investment & Securities, noted, "There are also reports of President Trump pressuring for semiconductor investment in the U.S., so we need to see whether the current trend will hold." (다만 기업들의 달러 매도가 계속 이어질 수는 없기 때문에 이달 하순의 흐름을 지켜봐야 한다는 지적이 나온다. 최광혁 엘에스(LS)증권 연구원은 최근 보고서를 통해 “하락 추세를 지속하기에는 힘이 약해지고 있는 시점”이라고 진단했다. 김대준 한국투자증권 연구원은 “트럼프 대통령의 반도체 (대미)투자 압박설도 나와 현재 추세가 유지될지 봐야 한다”고 지적했다.)

The domestic stock market plunged sharply, heavily affected by rising long-term U.S. Treasury yields and heightened tensions in the Middle East. On this day, the Kospi closed at 6,471.17, down 5.80% from the previous session, breaking below the 6,500 line. (국내 주식시장은 미 국채 장기금리 상승과 중동 긴장 고조 등 영향 크게 받아 급락했다. 이날 코스피는 전날보다 5.80% 떨어진 6471.17에 거래를 마치며 6500선을 이탈했다.)

Kim Ga-yoon, Reporter gayoon@hani.co.kr (김가윤 기자 gayoon@hani.co.kr)

item.title: SK Hynix Announces Record 40 Trillion Won Share Buyback and Cancellation... Also Moving to Expand Dividends (하이닉스, ‘역대 최대’ 40조 자사주 매입·소각…배당 확대도 추진)
item.description:
SK Hynix has pulled out a 40 trillion won share buyback and cancellation plan—the largest ever among domestic listed companies. The move is intended to support the stock price by significantly expanding shareholder returns, including share acquisition and cancellation and increased dividends, based on astronomical profits from the semiconductor supercycle. (에스케이(SK)하이닉스가 국내 상장사 가운데 역대 최대인 40조원 규모 자사주(기업이 취득하는 자기주식) 매입·소각 카드를 꺼내 들었다. 반도체 슈퍼사이클(초호황)에 따른 천문학적 이익을 토대로 자사주 취득·소각, 배당 확대 등 주주 환원을 대폭 확대해 주가를 떠받치겠다는 취지다.)

SK Hynix announced on the 19th that its board of directors held a meeting and decided on the new acquisition and cancellation of treasury shares worth 40 trillion and 4.34 billion won. This is the largest share cancellation case among domestic listed companies. To this end, the company plans to purchase 24.07 million shares on the open market over three months, starting the 20th of this month through November 19th, which amounts to 3.3% of total issued shares (based on the previous day's closing price of 1.662 million won per share). All acquired treasury shares will be canceled. Earlier this year, the company had already canceled 15.3 million treasury shares it held (worth approximately 12 trillion won at the time). (에스케이하이닉스는 19일 이사회를 열어 40조43억4천만원 규모의 자사주 신규 취득 및 소각을 결정했다고 밝혔다. 이는 국내 상장기업의 자사주 소각 사례 중 최대 규모다. 이를 위해 전체 발행 주식 수의 3.3%인 2407만주(전날 종가 주당 166만2천원 기준)를 이달 20일부터 오는 11월19일까지 석 달 동안 장내 매수할 계획이다. 취득한 자사주는 전량 소각하기로 했다. 앞서 올해 초 회사는 보유 중인 자사주 1530만주(당시 12조원 규모)를 소각한 바 있다.)

The company explained, "SK Hynix is leading the AI memory market and continuing to achieve record performance," adding, "This decision to acquire and cancel treasury shares was made based on the judgment that the company's intrinsic value—including business competitiveness, cash generation capability, and mid-to-long-term growth potential—has not been fully reflected in the current stock price." (회사 쪽은 “에스케이하이닉스는 인공지능(AI) 메모리 시장을 선도하며 사상 최대 실적을 이어가고 있다”며 “이번 자사주 취득·소각은 사업 경쟁력과 현금 창출력, 중장기 성장성 등 회사의 내재가치가 현재 주가에 충분히 반영되지 않았다는 판단에 따른 결정”이라고 설명했다.)

Currently, SK Hynix's stock price closed at 1.5 million won per share on this day, down 48.3% from this year's high of 2.919 million won per share (closing price on June 22nd). Given the sharp decline in the stock price, the company is seeking to boost the share price through the buyback and cancellation of treasury shares. Additionally, the company stated it would implement shareholder returns on a larger scale than previously planned. In the 'three-year (2025-2027) shareholder return plan' announced at the end of 2024, the company had said it would return 50% of cumulative free cash flow (FCF, the cash generated from operations minus capital expenditures) over three years to shareholders. However, it has now expanded the return ratio to '50% or more.' As securities firms estimate SK Hynix's free cash flow for this year alone to exceed well over 100 trillion won, there are expectations that additional large-scale shareholder return measures could follow. (현재 에스케이하이닉스 주가는 이날 종가 기준 주당 150만원으로, 올해 고점(6월22일 종가 기준 291만9천원) 대비 48.3% 급락한 상태다. 주가가 큰 폭으로 하락한 만큼, 자사주 매입·소각을 통한 주가 부양에 나서겠다는 것이다. 또한 회사 쪽은 주주 환원 규모를 기존 계획보다 더욱 확대해 시행하겠다고 밝혔다. 앞서 2024년 말 발표한 ‘3개년(2025∼2027년) 주주 환원 계획’에서는 “3년 치 누적 잉여현금흐름(FCF, 영업을 통해 벌어들인 현금에서 설비투자액을 빼고 남은 돈)의 50%를 재원으로 주주 환원을 하겠다”고 했지만, 이번에 ‘50% 이상’으로 환원 비중을 확대한 것이다. 증권가가 추산하는 에스케이하이닉스의 올해 치 잉여현금흐름만 100조원을 훌쩍 넘는 만큼, 앞으로도 대규모 추가 주주 환원 카드가 나올 수 있다는 전망이 나온다.)

In this regard, the company said, "We plan to review dividend expansion measures, including existing fixed dividends and special dividends," and added, "We will pursue additional shareholder returns by combining share acquisition and cancellation with dividends, taking into account cash flow and market conditions." Specific details on the scale of shareholder returns and the method of implementation will be disclosed during the announcement of third-quarter (July-September) earnings. (이와 관련해 회사 쪽은 “기존 고정 배당, 특별 배당 등을 포함한 배당 확대 방안을 검토할 계획”이라며 “현금 흐름과 시장 상황 등을 고려해 자사주 취득·소각과 배당을 병행하는 방식으로 추가 주주 환원을 추진하겠다”고 했다. 구체적인 주주 환원 규모와 이행 방식은 올해 3분기(7∼9월) 실적 발표 때 공개할 방침이다.)

Prior to this, there had been considerable dissatisfaction among shareholders in the market that SK Hynix's existing shareholder return plan—paying a fixed quarterly dividend of 375 won per share, totaling 1,500 won per share annually—was insufficient relative to the company's profits. When SK Hynix's shareholder return plan was announced after the market closed on this day, the company's stock price rebounded in the Nextrade (NXT) after-hours market. Although the stock plunged 9.75% during regular trading hours compared to the previous session, the news of shareholder returns after the close caused the stock to rebound, recovering a significant portion of the decline. (이에 앞서 시장에서는 주당 고정 배당금 1500원을 분기별(분기당 375원)로 나눠서 지급하는 기존 에스케이하이닉스의 주주 환원 방안이 회사의 이익에 견줘 미흡하다는 주주들의 불만이 적지 않았다. 이날 장 마감 후 에스케이하이닉스의 주주 환원 계획이 발표되자, 넥스트레이드(NXT) 애프터마켓에서 이 회사 주가는 반등했다. 이날 정규장에서 주가가 전 거래일 대비 9.75% 급락했으나, 장 마감 뒤 주주 환원 소식이 전해지며 주가가 반등해 낙폭을 상당 부분 만회했다.)

Park Jong-oh Reporter pjo2@hani.co.kr (박종오 기자 pjo2@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Going all-in on a chicken game" Samsung Electronics DX chooses to break through losses head-on (“치킨게임 감행” 삼성전자 DX, 적자 정면돌파 택해)
item.description:
Samsung Electronics has chosen a strategy of directly confronting losses in its set business (DX) division, which covers smartphones and home appliances, after posting its first quarterly operating loss recently amid surging memory prices. Though the loss-making trend is expected to continue for now, the company aims to strengthen its market dominance by expanding market share through a "chicken game" instead. (삼성전자가 메모리 가격 급등 여파 등으로 최근 첫 분기 적자를 낸 스마트폰·가전 등 완제품(DX) 부문의 정면 돌파 전략을 택했다. 당분간 적자 기조가 이어지겠지만, 외려 시장 점유율을 확대하는 ‘치킨 게임’을 통해 시장 지배력을 강화하겠다는 것이다.)

On the 19th, Samsung Electronics held a management briefing for employees at the Mobile R&D Center (R5) in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, chaired by CEO and set business head Roh Tae-moon. The set business division, which handles Galaxy smartphones, TVs, and home appliances, saw its operating profit in the first half of this year shrink to 2.1 trillion won, about a quarter of the 8 trillion won recorded in the same period last year. In particular, the second quarter posted an operating loss of 800 billion won, marking the division's first quarterly deficit since its launch in 2021. (삼성전자는 19일 경기 수원시 모바일연구소(R5)에서 노태문 대표이사 겸 완제품 부문장 주재로 임직원 대상 경영 현황 설명회를 했다. 삼성전자의 갤럭시 스마트폰·티브이·가전 사업 등을 담당하는 완제품 부문의 올해 상반기 영업이익은 2조1천억원으로 전년 동기(8조원) 대비 4분의 1수준으로 쪼그라들었다. 특히 지난 2분기 영업손실은 8천억원으로 2021년 부문 출범 후 첫 분기 적자를 기록했다.)

The company predicted that if the current surge in memory prices continues, the Mobile eXperience (MX) division, responsible for smartphones, will also find it difficult to escape losses for the time being. However, Samsung Electronics emphasized its resolve to push through head-on, outlining strategies for the set business division from the second half of this year onward, including expanding market share, improving fundamentals, and preparing innovative products. The strategy is to enter a "smartphone chicken game" that prioritizes expanding market share and revenue despite losses, with the goal of dominating the market's pie once memory prices normalize. (회사 쪽은 현재의 메모리 가격 상승세가 계속될 경우, 당분간 스마트폰을 담당하는 모바일경험(MX) 사업부도 적자를 탈출하기 어려울 것으로 예상했다. 그러나 삼성전자는 올해 하반기 이후의 완제품 부문 사업 전략으로 시장 점유율 확대, 체질 개선, 혁신 제품 준비 등을 제시하며 정면 돌파 의지를 강조했다. 적자를 무릅쓰고 시장 점유율과 매출을 확대하는 ‘스마트폰 치킨 게임’에 돌입해 메모리 가격 정상화 후 시장의 파이를 독식하겠다는 전략이다.)

The company also shared its position that, under the performance-based principle of "reward where there is performance," it will be difficult to provide additional performance bonuses to set business division employees for now. Given that since 2009 the company has maintained a "two companies under one roof" system, separating not only the businesses of the semiconductor division (DS) and the set business division but also personnel, finance, and accounting operations, the company stated that it is impossible to offer additional compensation to the set business division, which receives smaller bonuses compared to the semiconductor division. (‘성과 있는 곳에 보상 있다’는 성과주의 원칙에 따라 당분간 완제품 부문 직원들을 위한 추가 성과급 지급이 어렵다는 입장도 공유했다. 앞서 2009년부터 반도체 부문(DS)과 완제품 부문 간 사업은 물론 인사·재무·회계 등을 분리해 운영하는 ‘한 지붕 두 회사’ 체계를 유지하고 있는 만큼, 반도체 부문에 견줘 적은 성과급을 받는 완제품 부문에 추가 보상을 하는 것은 불가능하다는 것이 회사 쪽 입장이다.)

item.title: Kookmin University Holds 2025 Second-Half Degree Conferment Ceremony for 80th Anniversary (국민대, 개교 80주년 맞아 2025학년도 후기 학위수여식 개최)
item.description:
Kookmin University (President Jeong Seung-ryeol) held the '2025 Second-Half Degree Conferment Ceremony' by college and graduate school on Wednesday, August 19, to mark its 80th anniversary. At the ceremony, a total of 1,722 degrees were conferred, including 994 bachelor's, 608 master's, and 120 doctoral degrees. (국민대학교(총장 정승렬)가 개교 80주년을 맞아 8월 19일(수) ‘2025학년도 후기 학위수여식’을 각 단과대학과 대학원별로 개최했다. 이날 학위수여식에서는 학사 994명, 석사 608명, 박사 120명 등 총 1,722명이 학위를 받았다.)

This year's ceremony carried added significance as it took place in the year Kookmin University celebrated its 80th anniversary. Building on the achievements of the past 80 years, the university is preparing for a new leap forward by advancing its mid-to-long-term development strategy, 'KMU VISION 2035: EDGE'. (올해 학위수여식은 국민대가 개교 80주년을 맞는 해에 열린다는 점에서 의미를 더했다. 국민대는 지난 80년의 성과를 바탕으로 중장기 발전전략 ‘KMU VISION 2035: EDGE’를 추진하며 새로운 도약을 준비하고 있다.)

With the vision of being a 'university that sets the standard for higher education,' Kookmin University is enhancing its education, research, and industry-academia cooperation systems around four major development strategies and eight specialization fields. Additionally, through its 80th anniversary slogan, 'Make the Rule, Break the Rule,' the university has articulated its direction of challenge and innovation—moving beyond existing standards to create new ones. (국민대는 ‘고등교육의 표준을 제시하는 대학’을 비전으로, 4대 발전전략과 8대 특성화분야​를 중심으로 대학의 교육과 연구, 산학협력 체계를 고도화해 나가고 있다. 또한 개교 80주년 슬로건 ‘Make the Rule, Break the Rule’​을 통해 기존의 기준을 넘어 새로운 기준을 만들어가는 대학의 도전과 혁신 방향을 제시했다.)

Various projects commemorating the 80th anniversary are also underway. Following last year's 'Quantum Campus Declaration Ceremony' and 'Vision Declaration Ceremony,' this year the university has produced and distributed the 80th anniversary commemorative fonts 'Seonggok-che' and 'Haeong-che,' which embody the university's history and founding spirit. Through these and other anniversary projects, the university is sharing its historical assets and identity with its community and society. (개교 80주년을 기념한 다양한 사업도 진행 중이다. 지난해 ‘양자캠퍼스 선포식’과 ‘비전 선포식’을 개최한 데 이어, 올해는 대학의 역사와 설립정신을 담은 80주년 기념 폰트 ‘성곡체’와 ‘해옹체’를 제작·배포하는 등 대학의 역사적 자산과 정체성을 구성원 및 사회와 공유하기 위한 다양한 80주년 기념사업을 시행한다.)

Innovation in education continues as well. Kookmin University has established the College of Quantum Convergence and the College of Bio Convergence, while expanding improvements to the educational environment using AI and digital technologies, convergence education in response to industrial and societal changes, and customized student learning and career support. Through these efforts, the university is strengthening its foundation for cultivating talent equipped with the convergent thinking and problem-solving capabilities demanded by future society. (교육 분야의 혁신도 이어지고 있다. 국민대는 양자융합대학과 바이오융합대학을 신설하고, AI와 디지털 기술을 활용한 교육환경 개선, 산업 및 사회 변화에 대응한 융합교육, 학생 맞춤형 학습·진로 지원 등을 확대했다. 이를 통해 미래사회가 요구하는 융합적 사고와 문제해결 역량을 갖춘 인재 양성 기반을 강화하고 있다.)

In his congratulatory address, President Jeong Seung-ryeol said, "This year marks a meaningful moment for Kookmin University as it celebrates its 80th anniversary, reflecting on past growth and advancing toward a new future." He added, "Just as Kookmin University prepares for the future through 'KMU VISION 2035: EDGE' based on its 80-year history, I hope that all of you receiving degrees today and standing at a new starting line will broaden your own possibilities, drawing on the knowledge and experiences you have gained at the university." (정승렬 총장은 축사를 통해 “올해는 국민대학교가 개교 80주년을 맞아 지난 성장을 돌아보고 새로운 미래를 향해 나아가는 뜻깊은 해”라며 “국민대가 지난 80년의 역사를 바탕으로 ‘KMU VISION 2035: EDGE’를 통해 미래를 준비하듯, 오늘 학위를 받고 새로운 출발선에 선 여러분도 대학에서 쌓은 지식과 경험을 바탕으로 자신만의 가능성을 넓혀가길 바란다”고 말했다.)

He further stated, "The 80th anniversary slogan 'Make the Rule, Break the Rule' embodies Kookmin University's spirit of not remaining within existing standards but constantly challenging ourselves by creating new ones. I hope that you, our graduates, will grow into 'challenging Kookmin people' who carve out your own paths and set new standards in your respective places, rather than merely following predetermined routes. Kookmin University will always cheer on your new beginnings and challenges." (이어 “개교 80주년 슬로건 ‘Make the Rule, Break the Rule’에는 기존의 기준에 머무르지 않고 스스로 새로운 기준을 만들며 끊임없이 도전하자는 국민대의 정신이 담겨 있다”며 “졸업생 여러분도 정해진 길을 따르기보다 각자의 자리에서 자신만의 길을 개척하고 새로운 기준을 만들어가는 ‘도전하는 국민인’으로 성장하기를 바라며, 국민대학교도 여러분의 새로운 출발과 도전을 언제나 함께 응원하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Korea Food Industry Association Invites Indian Delegation for CEPA Improvement Negotiations (한국식품산업협회, 「인도 CEPA 개선협상 사절단」초청)
item.description:
The Korea Food Industry Association (Chairman Park Jin-sun, hereinafter "the Association") invited the Indian government delegation and officials from the Indian Embassy in Korea, who visited Korea for the improvement negotiations of the Korea-India Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), to the Korea Food Research Institute (located in Uiwang-si, Gyeonggi-do, hereinafter "the Institute") on August 18 to introduce the Institute's facilities and discuss ways to expand bilateral food industry cooperation. (한국식품산업협회(회장 박진선, 이하 협회)는 8월 18일 한국식품과학연구원(경기도 의왕시 소재, 이하 연구원)에서 한·인도 포괄적경제동반자협정(CEPA) 개선 협상을 위해 방한한 인도 정부 사절단과 주한 인도대사관 관계자들을 초청해 연구원 시설을 소개하고 양국 식품산업 협력 확대 방안을 논의했다.)

During the visit, the delegation toured the Institute's major testing and inspection facilities and research infrastructure, which is designated as a test and inspection agency by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and an ISO/IEC 17025 internationally accredited testing laboratory, confirming its analysis and testing systems and technical support capabilities for ensuring food safety. (이날 방문단은 식약처 시험·검사기관, ISO/IEC 17025 국제공인시험기관인 연구원의 주요 시험·검사 시설과 연구 인프라를 둘러보며 식품 안전성 확보를 위한 분석·시험 체계와 기술지원 역량을 확인했다.)

The Association also conveyed the difficulties that Korean food companies are experiencing on the ground regarding the CEPA improvement negotiations. In particular, it explained that the current CEPA rules of origin require both the change in tariff classification (CTH) and the value-added criterion (BD 40%) to be satisfied simultaneously, which places a burden on companies' utilization of the agreement, and requested that the CTH be recognized independently or that companies be allowed to receive preferential tariff treatment by meeting only one of the CTH or value-added criteria. (협회는 이날 CEPA 개선협상과 관련해 우리 식품기업들이 현장에서 겪고 있는 애로사항도 전달했다. 특히 현재 CEPA 원산지 결정 기준이 세번변경기준(CTH)과 부가가치기준(BD 40%)을 동시에 충족하도록 규정돼 있어 기업들의 협정 활용에 부담으로 작용하고 있다고 설명하고, 세번변경기준(CTH)을 단독으로 인정하거나 세번변경기준과 부가가치기준 가운데 하나만 충족해도 양허관세를 적용받을 수 있도록 검토해 달라고 요청했다.)

Chung Yong-ik, Vice Chairman of the Korea Food Industry Association, stated, "India is growing into a promising consumer market and production hub with a population of 1.4 billion, and interest from the domestic food industry is also increasing," adding, "We expect this visit to serve as an opportunity to strengthen Korea-India food industry cooperation and revitalize bilateral food trade through expanded use of the CEPA." (한국식품산업협회 정용익 부회장은 "인도가 14억 인구를 보유한 유망 소비시장 및 생산 거점으로 성장하고 있으며, 국내 식품업계의 관심도 높아지고 있다"며 "이번 방문이 한·인도 식품산업 협력을 강화하고, CEPA 활용 확대를 통한 양국 간 식품 교역 활성화의 계기가 될 것으로 기대한다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: 'Preview in Seoul 2026' Unfolding the Future of the Textile Industry (섬유산업의 내일을 펼치는 ‘프리뷰 인 서울 2026’)
item.description:
'Preview in Seoul 2026' (hereinafter referred to as PIS), established as a global textile sourcing exhibition, will be held for three days from the 19th to the 21st at Coex Hall A and The Platz, hosted by the Korea Federation of Textile Industries (Chairman Choi Byung-oh). (글로벌 섬유 소싱 전시회로 자리매김한  ‘프리뷰 인 서울  2026(Preview in  SEOUL 2026, 이하 PIS)’이 한국섬유산업연합회(회장 최병오) 주최로 오는 19일부터 21일까지 3일간 코엑스 A홀과 더플라츠에서 개최된다.)

This exhibition, with 267 domestic companies and 259 overseas companies participating, will feature a total of 526 companies across 784 booths. Exhibited items range from yarns, fabrics, knits, accessories, textile machinery, apparel, and fashion tech, encompassing the entire textile industry from sustainable eco-friendly fibers to high-tech functional materials and AI/digital solutions. (국내 267개사, 해외 259개사가 참가하는 이번 전시는 총 526개사, 784부스 규모로 구성된다. 전시 품목은 원사, 직물, 니트, 부자재, 섬유기계, 의류, 패션테크 등으로 지속 가능한 친환경 섬유에서 첨단 기능성 소재,  AI·디지털 솔루션에 이르기까지 섬유산업 전반을 아우른다.)

Hyosung TNC (18 companies), DMC (31 companies), KTC (12 companies), Gyeonggi Business & Science Accelerator (12 companies), Gyeonggi Textile Industry Association (11 companies), and the Spinners & Weavers Association (9 companies) will form joint pavilions. Key exhibitors include Wonchang Material, CJ Company, Shinhansanup, Deokseong Inco, Silon, Grutex, Daesung Zipper, Young Textile, Gioflex, and Daehyun TFC. (효성티앤씨(18개사), DMC(31개사), KTC(12개사), 경기도경제과학진흥원(12개사), 경기섬유산업연합회(11개사), 방직협회(9개사)가 공동관을 구성하며, 주요 참가업체는 원창머티리얼, 케이준컴퍼니, 신한산업, 덕성인코, 실론, 그루텍스, 대성지퍼, 영텍스타일, 지오플렉스, 대현티에프씨 등이다.)

Among overseas exhibitors, China holds the largest share with 223 companies. They are followed by Taiwan with 10 companies, Japan with 8 companies, along with companies from various countries such as Hong Kong, India, the United States, Pakistan, Vietnam, the Netherlands, Mongolia, Türkiye, and Thailand. (해외 참가업체는 중국이 223개사로 가장 큰 비중을 차지한다. 이어 대만 10개사, 일본 8개사를 비롯해 홍콩, 인도, 미국, 파키스탄, 베트남, 네덜란드, 몽골, 튀르키예, 태국 등 다양한 국가의 기업들이 참가한다.)

This year's opening ceremony will feature a calligraphy performance at Stage A in Hall A, expressing PIS's vision with a brush on a large canvas. This performance will bring the PIS concept visual and slogan to life on the canvas in real-time, concluding with the sealing of an official seal by Lee Min-woo, Director at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy; Choi Byung-oh, Chairman of the Korea Federation of Textile Industries; and Kim In-ho, CEO of Daehan Textile, who is participating in PIS for the 10th consecutive year this year. (올해 개막행사로는 PIS의 비전을 대형 캔버스에 붓으로 표현하는 캘리그라피 퍼포먼스를 A홀 스테이지A에서 선보인다. 이 퍼포먼스는 PIS 콘셉트 비주얼과 슬로건을 캔버스에 실시간으로 구현하며, 산업통상부 이민우 실장, 섬산련 최병오 회장과 올해 연속 10년째 PIS에 참가하는 대한방직 김인호 대표가 낙관을 찍는 것으로 마무리된다.)

3 Trend Zones, 2 Special Zones... Highlighting from the Latest Material Trends to Cutting-Edge Technology (3개 트렌드관, 2개 특별관 구성… 최신 소재 트렌드부터 첨단기술까지 조명)

This year, three trend zones — TREND NOW, PIS INDEX, and PIS INSPIRE — along with two special zones, Salon de PIS and TechSphere, have been organized. (올해는 트렌드 나우(TREND NOW), PIS 인덱스(INDEX), PIS 인스파이어    (INSPIRE) 등 3개의 트렌드관과 살롱 드 PIS(Salon de PIS), 테크스피어     (TechSphere) 둥 2개의 특별관을 구성한다.)

'TREND NOW,' located in Hall A, will showcase exhibitors' flagship products divided into three themes: CO-Habit, CO-Evolve, and CO-Create. 'PIS INDEX' is a promotional zone set up at the exhibition entrance, allowing visitors to review exhibitors' products and information at a glance. 'PIS INSPIRE,' located on the second floor of The Platz, will present 27/28 FW trend color proposals alongside finished fashion items created using exhibitors' materials. (A홀에 마련되는 ‘트렌드 나우’는 참가업체 주력 제품을 CO-Habit, CO-Evolve, CO-Create 등 3개 테마로 나눠 선보이며, ‘PIS 인덱스’ 는 참가업체의 제품과 정보를 한눈에 살펴볼 수 있는 홍보 존으로 전시장 입구에 마련된다. 2층 더플라츠에 구성되는 ‘PIS 인스파이어’에서는 27/28 FW 트렌드 컬러 제안과 함께 참가업체 소재를 활용해 제작한 패션 완제품이 전시된다.)

Fourteen companies, including Daehan Fabric, Vision World, Yeseong Textile, and ProG, will participate in 'Salon de PIS,' the premium textile zone. In 'TechSphere,' which introduces innovative companies based on cutting-edge technologies like AI, 10 companies including Raonbird, Liveforward, CA Planet, and TFC will present innovative technologies for the textile industry. (프리미엄 텍스타일 존인 ‘살롱 드 PIS’에는 대한패브릭, 비전월드, 예성텍스타일, 프로그 등 14개사가 참가한다. AI 등 첨단기술 기반의 혁신기업을 소개하는 ‘테크스피어’에는 라온버드, 리브포워드, 씨에이플래닛, 티에프씨 등 10개사가 참여해 섬유산업의 혁신 기술을 제시한다.)

Pre-Booking Appointments Up 18% Year-on-Year, Approximately 1,360 BMS Matches (사전 상담 예약 전년 대비 18% 증가, BMS 매칭 약 1,360건)

This year, around 200 invited overseas buyers, including representatives from premium brands and large vendors representing key global markets such as the Americas, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East, will visit PIS. (올해는 미주, 유럽, 아시아, 중동 등 전 세계 주요 시장을 대표하는 프리미엄 브랜드와 대형 벤더 관계자 등 200여 명의 해외 초청 바이어가 PIS를 방문한다.)

Notably, buyers from North America and Europe, which have shown steady growth each year, account for 51.0% of the total, while buyers from Asian regions such as Japan and Vietnam account for 47.5%. The participation is characterized by sourcing teams and R&D teams from global brand headquarters in North America, large fashion retail companies and general trading companies from Japan, and buyers based on production hubs from China and Vietnam. (특히, 매년 꾸준한 증가세를 보이고 있는 북미·유럽지역 바이어가 전체의 51.0%를 차지하며, 일본·베트남 등 아시아 지역 바이어는 47.5%로 집계된다. 북미는 글로벌 브랜드 본사의 소재 소싱팀과 R&D팀, 일본은 대형 패션유통기업과 종합상사, 중국·베트남은 생산거점을 기반으로 한 바이어의 참여가 특징이다.)

Furthermore, the Business Matching System (BMS) introduced last year has been further activated this year, showing approximately 1,360 matches, an 18% increase year-on-year. The overall match rate between buyers and exhibitors is estimated to reach around 50% this year.
